title: Bathyscaphe Trieste with USS Lewis (DE-535) over the Marianas Trench, 23 January 1960 (NH 96797).jpg
description: The U.S. Navy Bathyscaphe Trieste, just before her record dive to the bottom of the Marianas Trench, 23 January 1960. The destroyer escort USS Lewis (DE-535) is steaming by in the background.
